name: battlecard
title: Internal competitor battlecard
for_each: select id,name from competitors order by name

sections.title: Reviewed comparison points
sections.note: Internal working document. A recorded review is not legal clearance or permission to publish.
sections.sql: select statement,response,evidence,source_url,review_due from battlecards where competitor_id=$1 and usable order by statement

sections.title: Points withheld from use
sections.sql: select statement,status,review_due from battlecards where competitor_id=$1 and not coalesce(usable,false) order by statement

name: evidence-register
title: Source substantiation register
for_each: select id,name from competitors order by name

sections.title: Evidence and review record
sections.sql: select title,summary,source_url,observed_on,rights,reviewed_by,review_due from evidence where competitor_id=$1 order by observed_on desc

name: deal-brief
title: Competitive deal brief
for_each: select id,name from deals where outcome='open' order by name

sections.title: Reviewed talking points
sections.sql: select b.statement,b.response,b.source_url from battlecards b join deals d on d.competitor_id=b.competitor_id where d.id=$1 and b.usable order by b.statement
